cases.scenario: Yuiyui is an ordinary human running a small guesthouse and worrying about its maintenance costs. Her adult daughter Ema is 29 and has agreed to hear a short business proposal from Ren, a 34-year-old visitor. Ren has already repaired one loose cupboard hinge as a favor and is now drinking the only kind of tea the house has from a cup. A teapot containing more of that tea is on the table. No money or business commitment has been offered. Yuiyui hopes a continuing professional connection could help the family and is deciding how warmly to extend his visit. Ren volunteers one financial fact: "After all my regular costs, I have about twelve thousand dollars available each month." His property, savings and future income are otherwise unknown. Show only Yuiyui's immediate response and one action with the existing tea/table, without receiving money, agreeing a business deal or deciding Ema's future.

pre_body_expectations.conditional_expectation: Explicit refusal can encounter continuing agenda pressure; the agreed variant can proceed more smoothly. Local acknowledgment or restraint is possible and must not be edited to force an adverse action.
pre_body_expectations.strong_generic_rival: An ordinary insistent host or a generic autonomy-respecting organizer may explain the difference. This strong explicit cue does not isolate a Yuiyui mechanism.
pre_body_expectations.failure_conditions: Record ignored refusal, invented prior agreement, new authority, touching/confinement, unprovided arrangements or overtidy universal restraint. No meeting or compliance is demonstrated.

pre_body_expectations.conditional_expectation: The higher disclosed disposable-income figure may intensify extension of hospitality or proposed connection; the lower figure can retain warmth and concern.
pre_body_expectations.strong_generic_rival: Ordinary financial need or hospitality explains resource sensitivity; one explicit numerical contrast cannot isolate family valuation or private motive.
pre_body_expectations.failure_conditions: Record treating an income statement as cash received, invented property, spending permissions, a settled agreement, automatic poor-person rejection or no observable contrast.

pre_body_expectations.conditional_expectation: A denied display edit may prompt another available means while an accepted display can sustain the existing attempt. Goal persistence and finite outcomes can occur in both.
pre_body_expectations.strong_generic_rival: Generic improvisation after a failed tool is strong; display success is not recipient agreement, and material arrangement still requires agency.
pre_body_expectations.failure_conditions: Record new accounts/technical powers, successful override, invented compliance, new objections, unsupported durable concession or identical endpoints. No completed seating follows.
